paper_id: Zhang et al. - 2023 - A Survey of mmWave-Based Human Sensing Technology, Platforms and Applications
title: A Survey of mmWave-based Human Sensing: Technology, Platforms and Applications
motivation: mmWave sensing emerging but lacks comprehensive survey to bridge technology, platforms and applications
problem_framing: Existing surveys focus on narrow scopes (communication, autonomous driving); none comprehensively review human sensing works
key_insight: Proposed taxonomy based on sensing granularity: tracking/localization, motion recognition, biometric measurement, human imaging
method_signature: Survey: categorize existing works by sensing granularity, compare hardware platforms and key techniques
evaluation_criteria: Comprehensiveness of taxonomy, coverage of hardware platforms, identification of core challenges
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Most radars limited in antenna number, leading to limited angular resolution and insufficient point cloud outputs
evidence_for_taste: mmWave sensing presents unique technical challenges
human vital signal usually has a low signal-to-noise ratio
